clips.title: The story
paras: During the Lunar Festival, travelers in Durotar can honor Runetotem the Elder, an ancestral spirit. She waits in Razor Hill beneath a beam of heavenly light, offering blessings and festival tokens to those who remember the past.

During the Lunar Festival, spirits of ancient elders appear across Azeroth to commune with the living. Elder Runetotem waits inside Razor Hill, just past the southern entrance. A beam of starlight falls on her as she watches over the orcish settlement. Travelers can pause there to honor the wisdom of those who came before.

When you pay Elder Runetotem homage, she gives you a festival token of fortune and tells you where other spirits can be found. Her directions point toward Elder Darkhorn and Elder High Mountain elsewhere across the continent.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Your spirit burns with life, young adventurer. I accept the homage you pay, and offer in return this token...
